描述_EN: decorations show the chinese character of longevity, wan shou; lotus flowers and geometrical patterns. orange velvet over painted with black ink to imitate the pelt of a tiger. man's jacket of embroidered silk satin and velvet, probably a theatrical costume. there is also a flap at the centre front and the tunic is lined in red silk. the velvet, representing the colour of a tiger's skin, symbolises physical strength and courage. theatrical imperial hunting tunic, tunic with mandarin collar, front opening, slits at side seams and flaps under arms. made of silk 'gobelin', brocade, velvet, satin, and embroidery. lined with red silk.
描述_ZN: decorations show the chinese character of longevity, wan shou; lotus flowers and geometrical patterns. 橙色的天鹅绒，上面用黑色的墨水涂抹，模仿老虎的皮毛。 男子的绣花丝缎和天鹅绒外套，可能是戏剧服装。 前面中间有一个翻盖，外衣的内衬是红色的丝绸。 天鹅绒，代表虎皮的颜色，象征着身体的力量和勇气。 戏剧性的御用狩猎长衫，长衫有鸳鸯领，正面开口，侧缝有缝隙，手臂下有挡板。 由丝绸 "哥布林"、锦缎、天鹅绒、绸缎和刺绣制成。 有红色丝绸的衬里。
